diagnostic_context.problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.

model_output.issue: Windows laptop can't connect to campus Wi-Fi after password change
model_output.likely_cause: Cached old password on Windows device
recommended_steps: Forget eduroam network in Windows settings
Reconnect to Wi-Fi and enter new password
